# HyperCosmosVR — Complete 25-Experience VR Documentary Visuals Specification

> **Design North Star:** *A rich, active world that feels present around the viewer and explains its processes visually, even with narration and text disabled. Use credible materials, lighting, scale, detail and causality, with holographic spatial instruments and no flat UI in VR. Preserve OLED black where space is empty; let real environments fill the view.*

### Acceptance priority and evidence (2026-11-15)

Richness, visual learning and presence take priority over increasing coverage counts or reaching 120 FPS. The user accepts **30 application FPS minimum, 90 middle and 120 upper target**, at **1440p–4K reference resolutions**. These are targets rather than shipped presets or measured guarantees. PSVR2 at 120 Hz and SteamVR's recommended render size is the personal hardware reference; higher-end OLED headsets also matter. Report exact stereo eye dimensions and scale instead of treating “4K” as a complete resolution description.

Distinguish native application frames from display refresh and compositor synthesis/repeats. Record application CPU/GPU times, actual FPS, display Hz, reprojection/repeated/dropped frames, compositor cost, hardware/runtime and capture duration. A desktop or offscreen result cannot certify physical-headset performance or perceived quality. Nominal 33.33/11.11/8.33 ms frame intervals are planning budgets; runtime/compositor work and stable pacing still have to be measured.

Review continuous, muted, caption-free scenes through cause, transport, interaction and consequence. Inspect both eyes, tracked translation, near detail, surrounding context and stationary observation. An unfamiliar viewer's description of what happened is evidence of comprehension; unique feature pixels, a single screenshot or the author's judgment are not. Do not automatically award a quality score or documentary-quality status when a package lands. This specification includes aspirations as well as implementation notes; verify each claimed behavior in code and captures.

No fixed percentage of the full image must remain black. Empty space should remain black, while close horizons, atmosphere, clouds, biological interiors and other populated environments can occupy most of the view. Likewise, fixed raymarch-step ceilings must not force visibly inadequate sampling. Choose scene-specific budgets from visual stability and measured cost at the declared tier. These acceptance rules supersede older overview-only percentage-black and 90/120-only prescriptions below and in linked package cards.

### Earth flagship: scientific and visual review requirements

The opening connects recognizable daylight geography and an atmospheric horizon with a wider magnetic-environment demonstration and a close nightside aurora. Observe the natural world at consistent physical scale; invisible field lines and particle traces are explanatory overlays, with accelerated time documented as such. Static observations must retain the authored camera pose through spoken sentence boundaries, and close horizons use local radial up.

The Earth material combines daytime imagery from July 2004, nighttime lights from 2016 and NASA SVS/NOAA CPC cloud imagery from 2014-06-02 00:00 UTC, with cloud imagery from the older Blue Marble 2002 release filling missing polar coverage (blended at 50–59° latitude). It is a multi-epoch illustration, not a contemporaneous observation or live weather reconstruction. Cloud advection and the timed magnetic event are illustrative. The magnetic field uses a centered dipole aligned to geographic Y; it does not reconstruct Earth's tilted, offset, time-dependent measured field. The fixed Sun direction `(0.62, 0.35, -0.64)` is normalized, giving an approximately 21.4-degree solar declination compatible with Earth's 23.4-degree axial tilt, rather than assigning a real observation date. [NASA Earth facts](https://science.nasa.gov/earth/facts/)

- Separate the bow shock, magnetosheath and magnetopause. Typical reference distances are about 13–14 Earth radii for the bow shock and 10–11 for the dayside magnetopause, measured from Earth's center and variable with conditions. A shell just above the atmosphere is not a literal magnetosphere. [NASA magnetospheric geometry reference](https://pwg.gsfc.nasa.gov/Education/JAS1.htm)
- Show solar-wind energy coupling and a tail release before field-aligned precipitation. Do not imply that all incident particles travel intact around a close spherical shell and then hit the atmosphere. Tail reconnection can accelerate plasma both toward Earth and away from it; the visualization should make any selected pathway and omitted dynamics clear in its review record. [NASA MMS reconnection observations](https://www.nasa.gov/missions/mms/nasa-keeps-watch-over-space-explosions/)
- Keep auroral emission above the surface and distinguish the gases' visible response from the explanatory particle markers. NASA's approximate visible-color reference places green oxygen emission around 100–200 km and red oxygen emission above 200 km; nitrogen contributes blue and pink. The northern and southern observing geometry must be consistent with the Sun and selected magnetic oval. [NASA aurora reference](https://science.nasa.gov/sun/auroras/)
- Shared timing alone is insufficient: inspect spatial continuity between stages, the destination of precipitation and the subsequent emitting region. Record which field geometry, timescales and transport are illustrative. The 16-second repeating demonstration is not a literal forecast or a validated magnetohydrodynamic simulation.

**Legacy altitude lessons remain outside this acceptance scope.** Existing selected atmospheric/orbital overlays retain shell-relative illustrative placement and have not all received physical-scale or educational verification. In particular, the selected GEO marker remains at 1.7 Earth radii from the center, a physically incorrect location for geostationary orbit: the reference altitude is approximately 35,786 km above the surface, or 6.6 Earth radii from the center. [ESA orbit reference](https://www.esa.int/articles/about-us/directorates/space-transportation/types-of-orbits) These legacy lessons are absent from the new six-stop Earth opening. Do not extend its physical-scale claims to every existing Earth feature; require a separate review of geometry, observing poses and scientific meaning before accepting those lessons.

## 1. Global VR Procedural Architecture, Shader Allocation & Performance Budgets

### 1.1 Render Pass DAG & Shader Compilation Order
Every WGSL render and compute pipeline compiles with `common_oled.wgsl` prepended verbatim. Hero volumetric documentary shaders share one unified raymarching pass concatenating `common_oled.wgsl` -> `doc_common.wgsl` -> `hero_doc_cosmos.wgsl` -> `hero_doc_matter_mind.wgsl` -> `hero_doc_civilization_horizon.wgsl` -> `hero_volumetric.wgsl` (`CullMode::Front` unit cube `[-1, 1]^3`, Stereo Multiview `@builtin(view_index)`):

1. **Compute Simulation & PDE Pass (`compute_universe.wgsl`):**
   - `cs_advect_particles` (`@workgroup_size(256,1,1)`): updates up to `DEFAULT_PARTICLE_CAP = 65_536` (`DEFAULT_PARTICLE_COUNT = 32_768` default active) `SimParticle`s (`64 B` stride) across modes `0..15+` (`0` MW spiral, `1` Laniakea streamlines, `2` Cosmic Web Zel'dovich ridges, `3` QCD quarks, `4` atomic orbitals via `eval_spherical_orbital_density`, `5` Planck spin-foam, `6` Complexity Turing/BZ waves, `7` Connectome neural sparks, `8` App `02` cymatic ripples, `9` App `01` dwell-attracted chromatic motes, `10` Keplerian Asteroid/Kuiper belt, `11` Geodynamo & trade winds, `12` Rayleigh-Benard prebiotic swarm, `13` Cosmological redshift photon stream, `14` Transformer optical bus lattice, `15+` SETI & 25-Petal Hyper-Lotus convergence).
   - `cs_field_grid` (`@workgroup_size(8,8,1)`): updates 2D `rgba16float` ping-pong PDE textures across modes `0..2` (`0` Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion for App `15`, `1` Chladni cymatics for App `02`, `2+` auroral magnetospheric field curtain for App `03` Thermosphere).
2. **Boundaryless Far-Shell Pass (`far_shell.wgsl`):** Fullscreen triangle at Reversed-Z `z = 0.0`, `depth_write = false`. Renders tight galactic star belt (black in intended empty-space regions), blackbody stars, CMB `2.7K` sphere (`cmb_alpha`), Inflation field (`inflation_alpha`), Quantum void (`quantum_void_alpha`), Cosmic Web backdrop, and Outer Horizon Lotus (`lotus_alpha`).
3. **Analytical Hero Surface Pass (`hero_volumetric.wgsl` -> `fs_hero_surface`):** Exact analytical ray-sphere/cutaway intersections writing Reversed-Z `@builtin(frag_depth)` (`depth_write = true`, `CompareFunction::GreaterEqual`): `0` Earth surface + quarter cutaway interior (`03`), `1..3` Solar System planets/photosphere (`04`), `4` Kerr event-horizon core (`05, 12, 14`).
4. **Foveated Documentary Volumetric Pass (`hero_volumetric.wgsl` -> `fs_hero_volume`):** Premultiplied alpha blending (`depth_write = false`), jittered with `128x128` blue noise (`blue_noise_128.png`) and foveated step modulation (`fovea_step_factor`: `1.0` inside `fovea_rad`, smoothly tapering to `0.42` in lens periphery):
   - `kind = 0`: Earth magnetospheric Van Allen shells + anchored polar aurora (`03`)
   - `kind = 2`: Saturn/Uranus analytical rings + Cassini/Encke gaps (`vid=0,1`) & Goldilocks habitable annulus (`vid=3`, `21`)
   - `kind = 3`: Macro cosmological nebulae & landmarks (`vid=4` corona, `6` Local Group, `7` Laniakea+M87, `8` Voronoi Web, `9` Observable Horizon, `20` Heliopause, `21` Orion Pillars, `22` Local Bubble, `23+` Early Universe Plasma/QGP/Electroweak/Inflation)
   - `kind = 4`: Relativistic geodesic Kerr lensing + Doppler accretion disk (`vid=5` Barred MW, `11` Einstein Cross, `12` Hawking Polar Jets, `14` Binary GW Inspiral)
   - `kind = 5`: **App `01` Colors** (`march_doc_colors`: Newton Prism + 7 Rays, L/M/S Cones, 3D HSL Bicone + Live Target Bead, Bohr Rings, 12-Channel Tetrachromacy Crown)
   - `kind = 6`: **App `02` Music** (`march_doc_music`: Equatorial Chladni Plate + 48-String Chromatic Harp, plus Chambers `vid=11` Cristal, `12` Aire, `13` Cálido, `14` Profundo)
   - `kind = 7`: **Apps `13 & 14`** (`march_doc_matter_spacetime`: `vid 10..19` Matter `H2O/Benzene`, `2p/3dz2` orbitals, RGB QCD bag, Higgs Mexican Hat, Noether Torus; `vid 20..29` Spacetime Minkowski Light Cones, Flamm Well + Mercury Rosette, Binary GW Strain, Planck Spin-Foam + Calabi-Yau Loops)
   - `kind = 8`: **Apps `15, 16 & 17`** (`march_doc_bio_mind`: `vid 10..19` Lorenz Scroll, Rayleigh-Benard + Gray-Scott, Eigen Hypercycle, Budding Protocell; `vid 20..29` B-DNA Helix, Chloroplast ATP Turbine, Folded Mitochondrion, 3-Domain LUCA Tree, Saltatory Axon; `vid 30..39` Sculpted 3D `mm_brain_sdf` Cortex + Callosum + Hippocampal C-Arcs)
   - `kind = 9`: **Apps `11, 12 & 18..25`** (`raymarch_doc_civilization_horizon`: `vid=exp_id` or `exp_id*10 + sub`: Epistemic Hubble/CMB/Lens/BBN Strata, Twin-Galaxy Merger / Red Dwarf Ember / Hawking Escape / Arrow-of-Time Cone, Acropolis Tiers & Cultural Monuments, Clockwork Gears / Tesla Coils / Microchip / CRISPR / AI Transformer Cube, Tokamak / O'Neill / Dyson Swarm, Europa Plumes & Goldilocks Exoplanet, SETI Dish / Prime Rings, 6-Lens Alien Sensory Mandala, Biosphere Mote + Value Scales, Nested Horizon Geodesics + 25-Petal Hyper-Lotus)
5. **GPU-Instanced Sprite & Diegetic Pass (`instanced_sprites.wgsl`):** Zero-VB billboard expansion up to `DEFAULT_SPRITE_CAP = 32_768` (`64 B` `SpriteInstance`) + `SimParticle` readback across `SpriteKind 0..7`: `0` Blackbody diffraction stars, `1` Flow/filament ribbons, `2` Asteroid/Kuiper shards, `3` Biosignature spectral rings (`sub_param<=0.5`) & pinpoint spectral beacon gems (`>0.5`), `4` Diegetic wrist resonance beads (`<=0.5`) & dwell focus shimmer (`>0.5`), `5` Hexagonal Dyson collector mirror glints (`sub_p>0.75`), analytic mini-moon/exoplanet/quark spheres (`>0.25`) & starburst sparks (`<=0.25`), `6` Minkowski light cones / SETI radio wedges, `7` Hairline orbital tracks & radar ping ticks. Minimum angular pixel size clamp (`min_pixel_size`) prevents stereo sub-pixel star shimmer.
6. **World-Space 3D MSDF Live-Ink Typography Pass (`msdf_text.wgsl` / `cosmos_typo`):** Renders obsidian-haloed glyphs (`halo_color = (0.002, 0.003, 0.006)`, `112 B` stride) synced character-by-character via `reveal_cursor` and leader filaments (`TetherInstance`, `48 B` stride) anchored **outside the central 12-degree foveal focal sphere** so explanatory text never occludes the procedural 3D hero geometry.
7. **Post-Processing OLED Preservation & AgX Pass (`post_bloom_agx.wgsl`):** Dual-Kawase bloom with strict HDR prefilter (`bloom_thresh >= 1.05`, `bloom_soft_knee = 0.25`) + Karis firefly suppression, optional edge chromatic dispersion, AgX filmic OLED tonemapping, `void_floor_eps = 1e-5` hard `#000000` gate (`oled_void_clamp`), and TPDF `128x128` blue-noise dither.

**VR Presence & OLED Composition Requirements:**
1. **Scene-dependent OLED contrast:** Keep actual empty space black without adding unrelated ambient fog; preserve real scattering, faint emission and populated foregrounds where physically appropriate. No full-frame black-percentage target applies to a close horizon or interior. Inspect exposure and local contrast in the scene itself.
2. **Zero Flat 2D Cards or Canvas Posters in 3D:** Every 2D rounded-rect diagram (`App 18-25` cards, selection frames, footers) becomes sculpted 3D wireframe/torus/polyhedral/MSDF-anchored volumetric structure or holographic diegetic ring.
3. **Rest-to-Learn Choreography (900 ms Dwell -> Feature Spotlight):** While moving (`MOVING`), narration dissolves cleanly and all zone features stay balanced at macro salience (`0.55-0.80`). After `200-900 ms` dwell (`SETTLING` -> `LOCKED`), the focused target receives a subtle `zone.color` dwell ring (`SpriteKind=4 sub_param>0.5`); during `NARRATING`, `emphasis_boost = 0.95` isolates the active `feature[k]` structure cleanly without jarring luminance jumps or photosensitive strobing.

## 2. `DocumentaryFocusState` <-> `DocumentaryCueSnapshot` Telemetry Contract

### 2.1 Rust & WGSL Synchronized Payload
[NarrationPlan::documentary_snapshot](file:///D:/Projects/Simulations/HyperCosmosVR/crates/cosmos_narration/src/resolver.rs#L293-L321) exports `DocumentaryCueSnapshot`, which drives [DocumentaryFocusState](file:///D:/Projects/Simulations/HyperCosmosVR/crates/cosmos_render/src/universe_scene.rs#L16-L25) and [pack_doc_tags](file:///D:/Projects/Simulations/HyperCosmosVR/crates/cosmos_render/src/doc_stages.rs#L15-L77), packing bit-exact into every `HeroVolumeInstance` without expanding the `112 B` GPU struct:

```text
HeroVolumeInstance.kind_tags.z (u32):
  bits [ 0..15] -> doc_zone(inst)   : active_zone_index (0..27, or 0xFFFF for overview / App 01 / App 02)
  bits [16..23] -> doc_feat(inst)   : active_feature_index (0..254; 0xFF = zone macro / no feature lock)
  bits [24..31] -> doc_scene(inst)  : (scene_index + 1) clamped 1..254; 0 decodes to -1

HeroVolumeInstance.kind_tags.w (u32):
  bits [ 0.. 7] -> doc_flags        : structural flags (bit0 = Deep Earth cutaway, bit1 = lensing)
  bits [ 8..15] -> doc_cue(inst)    : round(narration_cue_progress * 255)   -> live SyncVoice pulse [0..1]
  bits [16..23] -> doc_weight(inst) : round(narration_active_weight * 255)  -> active rest emphasis [0..1]
  bits [24..31] -> doc_submode(inst): domain sub-shader / App 01/02 timbre or active highlight override
```

| **Apps `03..25` Zonal** | `range_start` (`y0`/`x0`/`p0`) | `range_end` (`y1`/`x1`/`p1`) | `phys_low` (`low`/`au0`) | `phys_high` (`high`/`au1`) | Propagated directly to `u_frame.stereo_params.w` (`active_region_phase`), `u_frame.region_accent` (linear HDR zone color), and radial/thermal bounds. |

### 2.3 Critical Multi-Zone & Feature-Switch Disambiguation Rules
1. **App `22` Shared `scene_index` Disambiguation (`28` zones -> `23` `SCENES` functions):** Six pairs of distinct zones share identical `scene_index` IDs (`[0,1]->0`, `[2,3]->1`, `[9,10]->8`, `[15,16]->13`, `[17,18]->14`, `[19,20]->15`). Shaders MUST NEVER key off `doc_scene(inst)` alone for App `22`; always modulate geometry phase, orbital beacon angle, and primary emission tint using `doc_zone(inst)` + `zone_accent_rgb` + `doc_feat(inst)` so each zone has an unmistakable VR signature.
2. **Apps `23, 24, 25` Feature-Driven Sub-Geometry (`selectedFrame` Equivalent):** In source `scene.js` for `23..25`, highlighting one of the `6` features per zone (`doc_feat = 0..5`) mutates internal sub-frames (`cognitive-limits`, `alien-perspective`, `unknown-senses`, `other-individuality`, `multiple-math`, `causal-models`, `drawMeaningPackets`, `drawHorizonPackets`). Whenever `doc_feat < 6`, `march_doc_horizon_endgame` boosts the corresponding lens facet (`(scene + zone + feat) % 6`), balance pan weight, or geodesic packet node by `1.45x` with a hairline `region_accent` locator ring.
3. **App `25` Progressive Thermodynamic Fade (`z = 0..24`):** Across zones `0 -> 24`, global scene energy smoothly decays along `progress = z / 24.0`: HDR brightness scalar `dim = 1.0 - progress * 0.72`, simulation/rotation speed `motion = 1.0 - progress * 0.87`, active background star/node density `visible_fraction = 1.0 - progress * 0.82`, and internal animation phase rate `(1.0 - 0.82 * progress)` — guiding the user cleanly from multi-galaxy engineering into calm, dark Heat Death OLED stillness.
4. **Voice & Audio Modulation Guardrails:** `voice_rms`, `bass_energy`, and `narration_cue_progress` act strictly as smooth multiplicative rim/pulse envelopes (`0.72..1.35x` clamped) synced with spoken syllables and SyncVoice `reveal_cursor`. Zero abrupt strobe flashes.
